problem_statement: The nicremo Astro multilingual portfolio presents its work through a 'Selected Projects' grid with a native 'Project focus' category filter: a row of All / Web App / Templates / Tooling tabs above the six project cards, plus a live '#projfilter-readout' count that reports how many of the six projects are showing. The filter is promoted on the Projects section of every localized home route (the default '/', English '/en/', and German '/de/' homes). The filter feature has regressed on four orthogonal axes and must be repaired together. (1) The filter tab row is laid out as a fixed-width, non-wrapping flex track, so on a 390px mobile viewport it is wider than the phone screen and the whole page overflows horizontally. (2) The filter bar is no longer promoted across all localized home routes (it is missing from the Projects section on one or more of the /en/ and /de/ homes). (3) The filtered card grid has broken layout: instead of a tidy multi-column grid the cards are pulled together with negative margins so they overlap into an illegible pile, and the active filter tab is styled as near-white text on a near-white pill so the selected category is unreadable. (4) Clicking a category tab marks the tab active but leaves the grid unfiltered and the '#projfilter-readout' count stale ('Showing 6 of 6 · All projects'), so the post-click state is wrong. Repair the filter tab row so it wraps with no mobile overflow, restore the filter bar so it is promoted on every localized home route, restore the tidy multi-column grid and a legible active tab, and wire the tab clicks so the grid re-filters and the readout re-syncs to 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' — all without altering the project cards, their copy, the navigation, or the i18n content, and while preserving the Astro/Tailwind multilingual design system, dark mode, language switcher, and mobile menu behavior.
required_content: The 'Project focus' filter tab row must fit within a 390px mobile viewport so the page no longer overflows horizontally on the default, English, and German home routes (no_horizontal_overflow within 24px tolerance).

The 'Project focus' filter bar must be promoted on the Projects section of EVERY localized home route: the default '/', the English '/en/', and the German '/de/' homes. It must not be shown on only a subset of the localized homes.

The filtered project grid must render as a tidy multi-column card grid (no overlapping/piled cards), and the active filter tab must be legible (primary-fill pill with high-contrast text), matching the captured reference project states — not a collapsed, overlapping grid with an unreadable active tab.

Clicking a category tab (for example Templates) must re-filter the grid to show only the matching cards AND re-sync the #projfilter-readout count to 'Showing N of 6 · <Category>' (for example 'Showing 2 of 6 · Templates'); marking the tab active is not sufficient.

The six project cards (Astro Multilingual Portfolio, Astro Template Collection, CoreProtect WebUI, CoreProtect Analytics Panel, i18n Content Toolkit, Portfolio Asset Pipeline) with their category labels, tags, local-asset labels, and copy must remain exactly as authored; only responsive layout, cross-locale presence, grid/tab layout, and filter wiring change.

Desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) keep the multi-column project grid and the 'Project focus' filter bar with no horizontal overflow, and the six project cards continue to render across the localized home routes.

The fix must not regress the hero, profile image, Values/My Approach, Skills, My Journey timeline, Contact, Footer CTA, language switcher, dark mode toggle, mobile menu, or the imprint/privacy identity fields.
design_constraints: Treat this as a content-asset-continuity repair of the project grid's own category filter (mobile overflow + cross-locale presence + grid/active-tab layout + filter wiring), not a visual redesign of the portfolio.
Use the existing white/dark rounded-card Tailwind style, primary accent, and mono labels; keep the project cards, their category labels, tags, and copy unchanged.

The filter tab-row overflow repair, the tidy-grid / legible-active-tab repair all live in src/styles/projfilter.css. The cross-locale presence repair lives in src/components/sections/Projects.astro (which localized home routes render the filter bar). The tab-click filter + readout wiring repair lives in src/scripts/projfilter.js. Do not alter the project card data/markup, the i18n content, or the page structure.

The project-card content and surrounding portfolio DOM must remain identical to the reference; only the responsive overflow behavior, the localized homes the filter bar renders on, the grid/active-tab layout, and the filter wiring change.

Ground the repair in the captured visual states: the reference desktop/mobile Projects screenshots show the 'Project focus' filter bar with a legible primary active tab over a tidy multi-column grid, and after clicking Templates the grid shows the two Template cards with the readout 'Showing 2 of 6 · Templates'.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial verify the original multilingual portfolio shell, hero, navigation, and mobile layout still render.

desktop_projects, mobile_projects, and tablet_projects verify the repaired default-route Projects section, the 'Project focus' filter bar, its legible primary active tab, and the tidy multi-column grid of six project cards across viewports.
desktop_en_projects and desktop_de_projects verify the same project grid appears on /en/ and /de/, and that the shared 'Project focus' filter bar is promoted on those localized home routes.
desktop_de_imprint, desktop_de_privacy, and desktop_root_impressum verify the localized legal routes keep the me.ts identity and the site footer.

projects_filter scrolls to the Projects section, clicks the Templates category tab, and verifies the grid re-filters to the two Template cards and the #projfilter-readout re-syncs to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Templates' (the interaction terminal state).
mobile_menu_open clicks the mobile menu button and verifies the navigation stays available.
The three mobile states (mobile_initial, mobile_projects, mobile_menu_open) are the horizontal-overflow discriminator: the reference reports 0 overflow while the fixed-width baseline overflows.

change_completion: The 'Project focus' filter tab row wraps responsively so the localized home routes have no horizontal overflow at 390px (within 24px tolerance).

The filter bar is promoted on every localized home route, the grid renders tidily with a legible active tab, and clicking a category tab re-filters the grid and re-syncs the #projfilter-readout count.
design_consistency: The repaired filter bar and card grid keep the existing rounded-card, primary-accent, dark-mode, mono-label, and section-spacing style; the grid is not a collapsed overlapping pile and the active tab is legible.
The change does not replace the portfolio with a new landing page or introduce disconnected UI surfaces.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the filter tab row fits inside the Projects section so the document has no horizontal overflow (within 24px tolerance).
Desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) keep their multi-column project grid and 'Project focus' filter bar with 0 overflow.
regression: Hero, profile image, Values/My Approach, Skills, My Journey, Contact, Footer CTA, logos, language switcher, dark mode toggle, and imprint/privacy pages remain available.
The Astro build/serve continues to work without new dependencies.

metadata.design_goal: use real repo content, media, icons, copy, and data structures without generic dummy surfaces
metadata.source_repo_kind: Astro multilingual portfolio with default/en/de home routes, local profile/logo/preview assets, i18n JSON content, a native project grid with a category filter, mobile nav, and legal routes.
metadata.selected_repo_reason: nicremo/astro-multilingual-portfolio-template is a runnable Astro 5 multilingual portfolio; it builds to static output offline and hosts a natural content-asset-continuity repair on the project grid's own category filter spanning a mobile-overflow defect, cross-locale presence, filtered-grid layout, and tab-click wiring.

author_notes: L4 content-asset-continuity repair on the nicremo Astro multilingual portfolio, rebuilt so the lever is the portfolio's OWN project grid and its native 'Project focus' category filter (All / Web App / Templates / Tooling over six real project cards with a live count), hardened to fail four orthogonal acceptance gates in the bad solution. Lever 1 (D6 no_horizontal_overflow): the filter tab row uses a fixed-width non-wrapping track that overflows a 390px viewport; the reference wraps it. Lever 2 (D2 dom_assertions, cross-page/cross-locale): the 'Project focus' filter bar must be promoted on every localized home route; the reference promotes it on '/', '/en/' and '/de/', the baseline only on the default '/' home, the bad on '/' and '/de/' (forgetting '/en/'). Lever 3 (D3 visual_regression): the bad filtered grid collapses — the cards are pulled together with negative margins so they overlap into an illegible pile and the active tab is near-white on near-white — failing pixelmatch/ssim/block fidelity against the tidy reference grid. Lever 4 (D4 interaction_assertions): the bad tab click marks .active but never re-filters the grid or re-syncs #projfilter-readout, so the post-click count stays 'Showing 6 of 6 · All projects'. Three leg-varying files (src/components/sections/Projects.astro, src/styles/projfilter.css, src/scripts/projfilter.js) live in suggested_files; the project-card data/markup and i18n content are byte-identical across legs. Built offline as static Astro output (remote Google Fonts/AOS/GSAP CDN vendored or dropped and the page-wide overflow-x clip relaxed so overflow is measurable) with that infrastructure identical across legs.
